headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before HARC Meeting on Wednesday, October 21
blurb: The October 21 HARC meeting is anchored by the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment Project — the Town of Telluride's own large-scale development at 860 Black Bear Rd, zoned Accommodations 2. HARC takes up Buildings 1 and 2 as one public hearing item and Buildings 3 and 4 as a second, both continued from August 19. Each application covers new construction outside the Telluride Historic Landmark District exceeding 5,000 square feet of floor area under LUC 7-203.B.2.a.1.
